description: Same parser, no fetching: emails (incl. obfuscated 'name [at] domain [dot] com'), phones, WhatsApp, social links, addresses, schema.org organisation data, and the contact-page links present. Free. Example: html '<a href="mailto:x@y.com">'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones[] (e164, international, region, type, source), whatsapp[], social{platform: [url, handle]}, addresses[], organization{}, pages[] (what was fetched, status) and summary{}, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Charged per page actually fetched; failed fetches are free. URLs are not logged.

base_url.description: Page URL, used to resolve relative links and decide which links are same-site.
base_url.title: Base Url

html.description: HTML (or plain text) you already have.
html.title: Html

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to interpret phone numbers written without a country code (e.g. 'AE', 'GB', 'US'). Omit if unknown.
region.title: Region
